Name: Junimo Artifact Dig Spots
Author: Seismothesaurus
Description:
[b][color=#00ffff]General Note About 1.3: Due to time constraints in real life, I will most likely not be updating my mods in the near future.  There have been significant changes to how the game works in terms of the code, we don't know for sure that nothing else will be changed after the beta, and I am not familiar with the tools necessary to make mods compatible.  Once everything is ironed out after the update, I'll look into compatibility as soon as I have time.  Thanks for your understanding.[/color][/b]


Hate the original dig spots and how impossible they are to see in some seasons?  Don't understand if they're worms or sticks or something else entirely?  Junimos can help put that whole ordeal behind you!  They'll twitch around on top of dig spots and disappear in a magic poof of most likely clay when you hoe the spot.

This mod provides a selection of five colours of Junimos to pick from - red, green, blue, purple, and [i]super ultra flashing rainbow instability detected[/i].  Unfortunately the colours can't be randomized, so you just have to pick your favourite.  The rainbow version uses one colour per pose, but as the frames aren't programmed to change evenly or smoothly, it can be a bit of an emotional journey to look at.  However, it has the benefit of being extra eye-catching.

To use this mod, simply choose which colour Junimo you want and rename the file to Cursors.xnb, then [b]BACK UP[/b] and replace your Cursors.xnb file in your Content\LooseSprites folder.  No SMAPI required.  [u]However, this mod is not compatible with any other mods that replace Cursors.xnb.[/u]  If you want to use this mod with my Garden Variety UI recolours,[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1358] please see that page[/url] for what combinations are available or how to put in a request for a combination of your choice.  

[b]Known Issues[/b]:
-Cursors.xnb may not load properly without correct capitalization, so check that first if there are problems.
-No other known issues.  Please let me know if you get any blood snow or other transparency oddities.  I did fix them before release, but I could've missed something.

[b]Changes in v1.1:[/b]
-Fixed a snow transparency overlapping tile issue.  Please download the new version!


[color=#e06666][b]WARNING:[/b] Do not download this mod from any place other than NexusMods or the Chucklefish forums! [url=http://www.stardewvalleymods.net/]WWW.STARDEWVALLEYMODS.NET[/url] STEALS MODS AND UPLOADS THEM ON THEIR WEBSITE WITHOUT PERMISSION. [b]DO NOT download any mods there! [/b]If you see my mods anywhere other than Nexus or the forums, please link me to the site asap. Thank you![/color]
